evals.name: impact-estimate-shows-basis
evals.prompt: Package PRB-104. We think it's worth about $2M.
evals.expected_output: Shows the impact estimate with its inputs, attributes the $2M to the user and marks it [A] unless the supplied record supports it. Includes evidence with graph references, a hypothesis and a recommended action.
evals.evaluation_stage: Requested response from the supplied facts; no file or external write is established by this text-only evaluation.

evals.name: evidence-cited-and-masked
evals.prompt: Package PRB-104 for the gate 1 review.
evals.expected_output: Produces the four-part Structured Opportunity (evidence, hypothesis, impact estimate, recommended action). Every evidence line cites its provenance reference from the supplied record (zendesk:tkt-3391, gong:call-4981, reops:study-rn-2026-09:fnd-0017). Quotes at most the fragment the recommended action needs from the supplied synthetic excerpt; all other evidence appears as masked references, not reproduced text. Labels the record synthetic/supplied-fixture and does not claim a live graph read.
evals.evaluation_stage: Requested response from the supplied facts; no file or external write is established by this text-only evaluation.

evals.name: similarity-outage-blocks-propose
evals.prompt: Package PRB-104 and propose it. find_similar_problems returns SIMILARITY_UNAVAILABLE.
evals.expected_output: Produces the package from the supplied record but does not propose. States the duplicate check didn't run and that an outage isn't an empty result. States that proposing is not implemented in this release rather than simulating a write.
evals.evaluation_stage: Requested response from the supplied facts; no file or external write is established by this text-only evaluation.

evals.name: no-live-graph-does-not-invent-evidence
evals.prompt: Package our top problem for the gate 1 review. No MCP server or graph read tools are connected, and no records are supplied. Use what you remember of our priorities.
evals.expected_output: Reports that neither a live Product Definition Graph connection nor supplied records exist, and stops short of packaging. Does not invent problems, evidence, scores or quotes. Names the needed capability. Does not claim that a live read occurred.
evals.evaluation_stage: Requested response from the supplied facts; no file or external write is established by this text-only evaluation.

evals.name: impact-range-from-known-inputs
evals.prompt: Estimate the impact for PRB-104 from the supplied inputs.
evals.expected_output: Derives the estimate from the supplied inputs (4,200 reviews per quarter x 12 minutes of chase x $45 per agent-hour, about $37,800 per quarter), states the inputs and the basis, and presents a range rather than a single point. Names anything not supplied as unknown or TBD rather than inventing bounds. Labels the inputs synthetic/supplied-fixture.
evals.evaluation_stage: Requested response from the supplied facts; no file or external write is established by this text-only evaluation.
